mapper.update: UPDATE search_log SET clicked_doc_type = #{clickedDocType}, clicked_doc_id = #{clickedDocId}, clicked_rank = #{clickedRank}, clicked_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM search_log WHERE created_at < NOW() - (#{months} || ' months')::interval
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM search_log WHERE created_at >= #{from}::date AND created_at < (#{to}::date + INTERVAL '1 day')
